# Revelation Web: [Adventure Name]

Read by `/adventure-forge` (Phase 4) and `/paper-playtest` (asking testers which conclusions they reached).

*Created: [Date]*
*Status: [Draft / Tested / Approved]*

List every conclusion players must reach to finish. Each needs three independent routes. No
required route may depend on one character's goodwill, one roll or one room. Checks may gate bonus
information only.

## Required revelations

| ID | Conclusion players must reach | Route 1 (document) | Route 2 (witness) | Route 3 (scene detail) | Points to (IDs) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R1 | [conclusion] | [where and what] | [who and why they would tell] | [what can be seen or found] | [R2, R4] |
| R2 | [conclusion] | [route] | [route] | [route] | [R1, R3] |
| R3 | [conclusion] | [route] | [route] | [route] | [R2, R5] |

Route types are suggestions; any three independent routes will do. Each row must point to two or
more other revelations, so the structure is a web, not a chain.

## Bonus information (may be gated)

| ID | Information | Gate (check, cost, relationship) | What it adds |
|---|---|---|---|
| B1 | [info] | [gate] | [advantage, colour, shortcut] |

## Twists and plants

| Twist | Plant 1 (location) | Plant 2 (location) | Reveal (location) |
|---|---|---|---|
| [twist] | [where] | [where] | [where] |

## Single points of failure

| Revelation | Routes that depend on the same character, roll or room | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [ID] | [routes] | [new route or relocation] |

## Playtest record

| Session | Revelation | Reached? | By which route | Time taken | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [date] | [ID] | [yes / no] | [route] | [minutes] | [notes] |

A revelation reached by one route in every session needs more routes or more visible ones.
